items.title: МВР задържа мъж и жена за сексуална експлоатация на момичета, сред тях и непълнолетна

items.en: Ministry of Interior detains a man and a woman for sexual exploitation of girls, including a minor

items.title: Вносът на стоки от трети страни расте няколко пъти над износа

items.en: Imports of goods from third countries grow several times faster than exports

items.en: The ruling party wants to decouple personal assistants' salaries from the minimum wage

items.title: Death toll in 86-vehicle chain crashes on Bulgaria’s Trakia Motorway is 12, with final figure pending
